m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify handoff completeness
m0-context.imperative: Read crew context (docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md), the handoff (g1-implementer-handoff.md), and verify that all required fields are present: task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions. Attest c1 when complete.

postconditions.statement: crew context + handoff loaded; handoff verified complete (task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present)

m1-red-tests.title: Write failing TDD tests for regime_readiness
m1-red-tests.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_regime_readiness.py with synthetic in-memory DataFrames that have KNOWN planted frac_team/tau/z values. Tests must be independent of data/ (no DB). Include: (a) analytical recovery of planted frac_team, (b) tau recovery from known RE spread, (c) z-std calibration from known residuals, (d) param_pair_corr from known 2x2 covariance blobs, (e) degenerate cases (single session per car, all-error, zero-variance, missing blob). Tests must fail (red) because regime_readiness.py does not yet exist.

preconditions.statement: context loaded and handoff verified complete

postconditions.statement: test file exists and fails with ImportError or similar (red phase confirmed)

constraints: Tests must NOT import from src.evo_predictor, latent_power, or compound_prior
Tests must be independent of data/ layer (no DB, no filesystem I/O)
Use synthetic in-memory DataFrames with known planted values

m2-implement.title: Implement regime_readiness.py (green phase)
m2-implement.imperative: Write src/physics/layer2/regime_readiness.py implementing: DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS, AxisReadiness dataclass, ComponentReadiness dataclass, compute_readiness(df, *, thresholds=DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS). The 4 metrics: (1) coverage per constructor/circuit, (2) separability via fit_two_way frac_team + param-pair correlation from 2x2 blobs, (3) cross-session stability via pool_random_effects + fit_drift, (4) covariance honesty via drift-aware standardized residuals. Import _cov_list from estimate_store. No evo imports. No I/O or plotting. Then run the tests to confirm green.

preconditions.statement: m1-red-tests complete: test file exists, red phase confirmed

constraints: No import from src.evo_predictor, latent_power, compound_prior
No DB/file I/O, no matplotlib, no CLI
Do not modify pooling.py, pool_driver.py, estimate_store.py
Import _cov_list from estimate_store for blob parsing
Honest covariance: param-pair separability reads real 2x2 blob

status_detail.reopen_reason: Commander rework 2: tau_resid must use leave-one-out detrend (in-sample gave tau_resid=0 everywhere)

m3-verify.title: Final verification: full tests pass + no evo import
m3-verify.imperative: Run the complete test suite for tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_regime_readiness.py and confirm green. Also grep src/physics/layer2/regime_readiness.py to confirm no evo imports. Collect evidence for the result.

preconditions.statement: m2-implement complete: regime_readiness.py written and initial tests pass

postconditions.statement: pytest tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_regime_readiness.py -q is green AND no evo import found in the new file
